reason: Provides a DSH web search provider that calls the conversation model's OpenAI Responses built-in web_search tool and converts returned searches and citations into DSH results.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供复用 OpenAI Responses 内置 web_search 工具的网页搜索提供程序，并将结果和引用转换为 DSH 格式。
summaries.en: Provides DSH with a web search provider that reuses the OpenAI Responses built-in web_search tool and converts results and citations into DSH format.

capabilities: Sends web search requests through an OpenAI Responses-compatible endpoint
Reuses configured model route settings and credential references
Parses web search results and citations into DSH format
